propositions: Codex has no Serena MCP entry despite the project relying on Serena/Pyright for semantic navigation.
Add a project-scoped STDIO serena MCP server to .codex/config.toml launched via uvx pinned to the verified upstream Serena commit.
The server argv uses the codex context and --project-from-cwd so each worktree self-activates without committing a user-specific path.
Serena startup is non-required with a 120-second startup timeout so failures are reported without blocking Codex.
Validation confirms codex mcp list shows the enabled serena entry in a trusted worktree and omits it outside the trusted project.
AGENTS.md documentation update was deferred to preserve the signed single-file scope.
